name: Welcome Email
subject: Welcome to {{company.name}}
previewText: Get started with your new account
description: Elegant welcome email with sophisticated typography and three-step onboarding guidance.
useCase: Send this template to new users after account activation. Provides warm welcome, introduces platform value, and guides users toward key first actions.
customizationGuide: Modify the three steps section to match your actual onboarding flow. Update copy to reflect your platform's specific features. Customize colors to match your brand identity.
engagementStrategy: Use serif typography for elegance. Include numbered steps for clarity. Strong visual hierarchy guides users to next actions. This template is designed for retention and engagement.
